summary:
Farmaptation, developed by Team Greecon Valley, is a climate adaptation platform designed to help farmers make more informed agricultural decisions using NASA data.
The platform analyzes climate factors such as temperature, precipitation, humidity, and soil productivity. Using these data, it estimates crop water requirements, identifies potential water deficits, evaluates crop suitability, and suggests alternative crops. Our main goal is to transform complex climate data into practical insights that help farmers adapt to climate change, manage water resources more effectively, and support sustainable agriculture. Farmaptation includes an interactive game that makes learning about climate change and sustainable agriculture more engaging for children. Through this experience, children can explore agricultural challenges and gain a better understanding of the importance of making climate-conscious decisions.

Greecon Valley's Project Solution

Field Shift is an interactive climate-smart agriculture and water-stress management platform designed to help farmers, students, and communities combat climate change challenges. By transforming complex NASA satellite observations and the FAO-56 Penman-Monteith hydrology model into an intuitive dashboard and an engaging, story-driven mini-game, our project connects advanced scientific data and real-world agricultural practices.How Does Our Solution Work

Field Shift helps users to analyze local meteorological conditions, soil moisture levels, and water requirements dynamically rather than relying on outdated traditional methods. The platform integrates real-time satellite data to calculate crop water stress index (CWSI) and guides users through optimal agricultural decision-making:

  • NASA Data Integration: Utilizes NASA POWER meteorological datasets and soil/vegetation monitoring indexes to evaluate environmental risks such as droughts, heatwaves, and water scarcity.
  • FAO-56 Hydrological Modeling: Implements professional evapotranspiration calculations to determine precise irrigation needs for different crops.
    • Wheat
    • Barley
    • Corn
    • Sunflower
    • Cotton
    • Chickpea
    • Lentil
    • Soybean
    • Sorghum
    • Safflower
  • Interactive Mini-Game (Field Shift: Farm Odyssey): Inspired by real agricultural resilience challenges, players navigate through multi-season scenarios where they manage water reserves, soil health, and financial budgets while applying NASA-backed adaptation strategies.

Project Benefits

Field Shift benefits farmers, agricultural students, and local communities by:

  • Educating players on climate disasters, water scarcity, and their direct impact on crop productivity.
  • Demonstrating practical, data-driven strategies for sustainable farming and resource conservation.
  • Making NASA’s open-source data accessible, actionable, and engaging for all age groups.

Our Goal

To foster global awareness of agricultural vulnerability and provide communities with the scientific tools needed to prepare for climate-related challenges. While focusing primarily on water-stress and crop adaptation, our platform lays the groundwork for scaling smart-farming solutions worldwide.

Tools and Technologies Used

  • Frontend Development: HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Lucide Icons
  • Scientific Models & Data Sources: NASA POWER APIs, FAO-56 Penman-Monteith equation
  • Development & Deployment: Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and Vercel
